title: Second norm of a centered affine function
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite set, let $\mathrm{law}$ be a probability mass function on $\Omega$, and let $X:\Omega\to\mathbb{R}$ have expectation $0$ and second moment $1$. For all $a,b\in\mathbb{R}$, the $L^2$ norm of the function $x\mapsto a+bX(x)$ with respect to $\mathrm{law}$ is $\sqrt{a^2+b^2}$.
hypotheses_covered: $\mathrm{law}$ is a probability mass function on $\Omega$
